overview_description.description: Deel offers a unified platform that supports payroll, HR, compliance, and workforce management across global teams. It enables companies to onboard and pay both full-time employees and independent contractors, managing local tax, benefits, and regulatory requirements in one system. Deel also provides Employer of Record (EOR) and Contractor of Record (COR) services, taking on legal responsibility for employment compliance while clients manage day-to-day work. The platform features contract generation, automated invoicing, multi-currency payments, a centralized HRIS, and integrations with other business systems.
